content: कुलक {%a.%} Of good family, of good birth. .{@-कः@} .²1 The chief of a guild. .²2 Any artisan of eminent birth. .²3 An ant-hill. .{@-कम्@} .²1 A collection, multitude. रोमपुलककुलकः <ls>Bhāg. 5. 7. 12</ls>. .²2 A number of verses in grammatical connection; (the number of verses ranging from 5 to 15 and the whole forming one sentence); {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} see <ls>Śi. 1. 4-10</ls>; <ls>R. 1. 5-9</ls>; so <ls>Ku. 1. 1-16</ls>. .²3 A kind of prose composition with few compounds.
